payload.core_composition_summary: Per-bit XOR calculation uses bit manipulation; array is sorted via iterative bit partitioning enabling efficient two-pointer counting of pairs with each bit set.
payload.rationale: Combines bitwise XOR accumulation with custom sorting (radix-style via bit partitioning) to enable two-pointer counting of pairwise sums for each bit.
